title: MILimbEEG: Motor and motor-imagery limb EEG dataset (MILimbEEG)
description: MILimbEEG is an EEG dataset of over 8,680 four-second recordings from 60 volunteers who performed and imagined upper- and lower-limb movements. The movements were hand closing (left and right) and dorsal and plantar foot flexion (left and right), with baseline eyes-open and rest conditions. Signals were recorded with a 16-channel dry-electrode OpenBCI Cyton+Daisy system at 125 Hz. The cohort includes healthy participants, amputees and post-COVID-19 individuals, and the data support brain-computer interface and motor imagery research.
methods_description: EEG was recorded at 125 Hz from 16 dry electrodes (10-10 montage) with an OpenBCI Cyton+Daisy and a neutral ear reference. A hardware band-pass of 5-50 Hz and a 60 Hz notch were applied. In each repetition, participants first executed and then imagined limb movements in cue-based visual trials of 4 s, alongside baseline eyes-open and rest periods.
